**STEP 1 — Scene:** A cafeteria meal: baked pasta with browned cheese and tomato/meat sauce, mixed fruit salad, and orange juice.

**STEP 2 — Vessels:** Estimated main plate diameter **24 cm**, area **452 cm²**; fruit bowl diameter **20 cm**, area **314 cm²**. The juice glass has an estimated internal diameter of **6 cm**, cross-sectional area **28 cm²**.

**STEP 3 — Items:** Baked pasta, including its visible sauce and cheese; fruit salad containing melon, watermelon, apple/pear pieces, and grapes; orange juice. No separate oil or dressing is clearly visible.

**STEPS 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:**

| Item | Vessel coverage | Area × average height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Baked pasta with sauce and cheese | 55% of plate | 249 cm² × 1.9 cm = 473 ml | 0.90 g/ml | 425 g | 170 | 723 kcal |
| Mixed fruit salad | 50% of bowl | 157 cm² × 2.0 cm = 314 ml | 0.60 g/ml | 188 g | 55 | 103 kcal |
| Orange juice | 100% of glass cross-section | 28 cm² × 10 cm fill depth = 280 ml | 1.00 g/ml | 280 g | 45 | 126 kcal |

The pasta and fruit coverage estimates refer to their separate vessels; sauce and cheese are included in the pasta estimate rather than counted twice.

**STEP 8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **613 g of solid food**, plus **280 g of juice**, is plausible for the visible substantial pasta portion and fruit bowl. Estimated meal total: **893 g and 952 kcal**. The pasta’s thickness and recipe are the largest uncertainties.
